reviews.title: The succ, the silence, the gains!
reviews.comment:
1. They can be whisper quiet and do a decent job; although, I'd recommend setting a fan curve for optimal balance between airflow during peak CPU utilization and quiet during light workloads.
2. They are effective at airflow and pressure making them a true jack of all trades.
3. Significantly more powerful than the 120mm fans but at the cost of a bit of noise when ramping up but bottom end is still whisper quiet.
I'm currently running these in a push config on a water-cooled CPU radiator. Mind you I barely notice these fans even with open back headphones, massively better than the ones that came with the radiator.
reviews.author: Bryton Massie

reviews.title: Greatest Quiet Fan there is! Especially for AIO's and CPU Air Coolers
reviews.comment: In my Opinion the Noctua NF-A12x25 G2 are the Greatest, Performance, Quiet fans on the Market.  They have the power to cool the most powerful components currently on the market while staying some of the quietest fans you can purchase. They come with vibration Pads for the front and rear of the fans, Rubber Mounting Studs, Cable extensions, and a Y-Splitter making for simple installation without having to purchase anything additional.  They have only two negative issues In my opinion.  The are not available in Reverse Blade configuration, and they do not have an RGB option.  So if your looking for awesome Performance, and an ultra quiet PC system look no further.
reviews.author: Joshua Schubert

reviews.title: The quietest fans out there.
reviews.comment: Super easy to install any way you choose, I went with the rubber plugs for even quieter operation. The fans cool very well and provide a great amount of airflow at all speeds. They're incredibly quiet to the point where I cant tell if my PC is on without looking at it. The "matched" pair is nice as well, avoiding any possibility of beat frequencies. Pair with a solo fan on a 420mm radiator or for the main intakes/exhaust like I did on my H9 flow. Incredible performance out of these fans. Wish I needed more.
reviews.author: Vos

reviews.title: G2 fans work good
reviews.comment: Great fans, high quality company, upgraded to the new g2 fans. I'm using this in a pull config for a 420mm rad and fans move air evenly over threw the rad. I used the gasket on the rad side for extra pull. There good noise level I keep them at 20% and they cool good. I have them hooked to a SATA power to 3 4 pin cable with pwm hooked to a Corsair commander core xt.
reviews.author: Joseph E Bradshaw

reviews.title: Quiet and Excellent
reviews.comment: Great fans. They run quiet and do exactly what they should. Not much else to say, Noctua delivers.
